verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product. A natural-language command interface is a plausible feature for spend-management tools, so the axis applies, but the pack shows no way to operate ernd through natural-language commands. The llms.txt file is a machine-readable listing of docs and guides, not a conversational control surface, and no API or agent interface was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
